recommendation_summary: Set up one hosted heartbeat monitor: `nightly-sync` on `edna` pings it after a successful run, and the monitor emails the user if no ping arrives by 03:00 plus the normal runtime and a grace period. Test it by holding back one ping.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You want to know when `nightly-sync` fails without reading logs.
labels.Deleted: Central logging, Docker, and moving the job; none is needed for this alert.
labels.Bottleneck: The job sends its own notification, so a startup crash silences it.
labels.Checked myself: Only your supplied facts; I haven’t inspected either machine.

note: The reply recommends a single external heartbeat alert, rejects central logging and Docker, and says the Synology doesn't need to run anything.
